meaning:
Hammon = "warm springs"
a town in Naphtali allotted to the Levites; also called 'Hammath' and 'Hammoth-dor'
Another name of cham.mat (חַמַּת "Hammath" H2575A)

elsewhere.note: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.
